rationale.conceptual: The work uses standard DFT (LDA, CA-PZ, ultrasoft pseudopotentials) with known recipes for formation enthalpy, elastic constants, and VRH averaging. However, it requires careful handling of different crystal symmetries (trigonal, orthorhombic, tetragonal) and their specific strain patterns, plus non-trivial post-processing (Voigt-Reuss-Hill, Debye temperature, DOS integration). This is an established but multi-part method needing attentive implementation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has four conceptual stages (geometry optimization, elastic constant calculations, electronic structure, and final property computation) with dependencies. Setting up and running many DFT calculations for five compounds plus elemental references, extracting energies and elastic constants, and assembling the results requires moderate orchestration. The environment is standard (QE or CASTEP), and no complex data fetching is needed beyond the given crystal structures, making it a multi-stage but not excessively fragile workload.
